title: Normalize stat path fields
objective: Update the existing sdlc/stat/v1 contract to remove requestedPath, retain repositoryPath as the repository-relative path, and add fullPath as the resolved absolute path; align work-item validation object results and tests with the same identity shape.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested preparation, processing, and per-task commits on the current repository.

request.text: Update sdlc work-item validate to use similar properties sdlc/stat/v1, except for the stat property, for the objects array. Commit changes.

scope.name: stat-path-contract
scope.description: Update the existing sdlc/stat/v1 response in place by removing requestedPath, retaining repositoryPath as repository-relative, and adding fullPath as the resolved absolute path.
scope.reason: The current requestedPath/repositoryPath pair is ambiguous because repositoryPath does not contain repository-root information and both values are usually identical.

scope.name: validation-object-alignment
scope.description: Apply the same path and object identity shape to work-item validation objects, excluding only the stat metadata object.
scope.reason: Stat and work-item validation should expose consistent object identity fields to consumers.

scope.name: contract-regression-tests
scope.description: Update focused and response-schema tests for repository-relative and absolute path semantics and removal of requestedPath.
scope.reason: The field rename/removal changes a persisted v1 contract and must be executable and explicit.

nonGoals.name: schema-version-bump
nonGoals.description: Do not create sdlc/stat/v2 or change the existing sdlc/stat/v1 identifier.
nonGoals.reason: The requested change is an in-place correction to the current contract.

nonGoals.name: repository-root-response
nonGoals.description: Do not add a separate repositoryRoot field; fullPath is the resolved absolute file path and repositoryPath is the repository-relative path.
nonGoals.reason: The requested contract distinguishes the file path forms without exposing a separate repository-root metadata field.

nonGoals.name: stat-semantics
nonGoals.description: Do not change Git tracking, containment, object classification, object references, filesystem metadata, or read-only behavior beyond the path-field correction.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0011 is a response-contract normalization rather than a stat behavior redesign.

items.name: stat-path-fields
items.description: sdlc/stat/v1 must remove requestedPath, retain repositoryPath as repository-relative, and add fullPath as an absolute resolved path.
items.reason: The current field naming is ambiguous and does not expose the resolved full path.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The persisted sdlc/stat/v1 schema requires repositoryPath and fullPath, does not define requestedPath, and remains closed.
Runtime stat output reports repositoryPath relative to the repository root and fullPath as an absolute filesystem path.

items.name: validation-object-path-alignment
items.description: Each work-item validation object must use repositoryPath and fullPath with the stat-compatible object identity fields and must not emit requestedPath.
items.reason: Validation object results should use the same path semantics as stat output.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Valid work-item validation responses contain repositoryPath and absolute fullPath for every object and contain no requestedPath field.

items.name: path-regression-tests
items.description: Focused tests must assert relative repositoryPath, absolute fullPath, removed requestedPath, and unchanged object/reference/schema behavior.
items.reason: The change modifies a persisted v1 response contract used by stat and work-item validation consumers.

acceptanceCriteria.description: yarn test passes with generic-file, work-item, task, and work-item-validation object path assertions.
Representative stat and work-item validation responses pass their persisted schemas and all repository schema audits pass.
